Media Manager is the repository of media files.  You can either upload the URL of the file or the file itself. Once uploaded, the file links can be copied and used in Email Composer and flow builder. Media manager allows you to upload various new file types within the media manager such as images, videos, audio files, and documents.

## 

Using Media Manager

On the media manager page, all the files uploaded to the media manager are listed here. You can copy the file URL to use in relevant nodes or in email composer as applicable. Every client has a storage limit of 1 GB and an error message appears after the limit is reached.

You can delete the media files from the Actions drop-down box if you don't require that specific file anymore.

 [Image: Interface showing a list of image assets within the Media Manager] 
Screenshot displaying a list of image assets in Media Manager.

### 

Import URL

Use the Import URL to add an image from a URL. Only files up to 10MB are allowed.

 [Image: Interface highlighting the Import URL option to upload an image directly from a specified URL] 
Screenshot showing the use of Import URL to add an image from a URL

### 

Upload

Click Upload and locate the relevant file on your PC to upload it to the media manager. Only files up to 10 MB are allowed.

 [Image: Interface displaying the option to upload an file. ] 
Screenshot showing the option to upload the file

Steps to upload the file:

- 

Upon uploading a file, the application identifies and displays the mime-type of the file uploaded. This enables you to edit the mime-type, if needed. 

- 

In the Upload File pop-up window, click Edit in the bottom-left to change the mime-type. or 

- 

Click Replace File to replace the previously uploaded file, if needed.

 [Image: Edit Mime Type] 
Edit Mime Type

 You will view the following screen if the system cannot recognize the mime-type.

 [Image: Mime-Type Not Recognised] 
Mime-type Not Recognised

- Click Update.

## 📘
Note

The mime-type will not be displayed for files that have already been uploaded.

### 

Copying the URL

Copy the file URL to use in Email Composer or Channel Nodes. Click Copy URL corresponding to the image as shown in the figure below, the URL is copied to the clipboard. 

 [Image: Interface highlighting the feature to copy the direct URL of media files uploaded in the Media Manager] 
Screenshot showing the option to copy the direct URL of media uploaded in the Media Manager
